CustomField.description: The link that reopens this saved submission: the Form Template's Web Form URL with the resume token as the resume parameter, which the form template reads with no URL Parameter Mapping. Blank when the template has no Web Form URL or the submission has no token. Merge it into the Save Progress email template. It carries the token, so site guests never read it. The link works once, and stops working on submit and after 7 days.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: The single-use link that reopens this saved submission. Merge it into the Save Progress email template.
CustomField.label: Save Progress Resume Link
